title: Song - Praise to the Lord
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand repeated chords on every beat
trains: Praise to the Lord in F major and 3/4, over the left-hand chord struck on every beat, up to two chords a bar (F, C, Dm, B♭, Gm).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1256-lobe-den-herren: Lobe den Herren (hymntune), SATB, sounding F major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1256)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1256), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: The left-hand repeated chords on every beat is our own (CC0).
